news.title: Artist Betye Saar, whose work reflects Black identity and spirituality, dies at 99
news.summary: A central figure of the 1960s Black Art Movement, Saar pioneered assemblage boxes, or sculptures made of found objects, and reclaimed Jim Crow-era memorabilia as powerful totems of Black liberation.
